description: This file defines a CKEditor 5 plugin class 'DrupalEntityLinkSuggestionsEditing' that manages custom link attributes related to Drupal entity links, including attribute conversion, command enhancements, and attribute cleanup during unlinking.

classes.name: DrupalEntityLinkSuggestionsEditing
classes.description: A CKEditor 5 plugin class that extends the base Plugin to add custom link attribute handling for Drupal entity links, including attribute conversion, command modifications, and cleanup.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, registers commands, and sets up attribute handling and command enhancements.

methods.name: _allowAndConvertExtraAttributes
methods.description: Extends the text schema to allow custom attributes and sets up conversion rules for downcast and upcast.

methods.name: _addExtraAttributesOnLinkCommandExecute
methods.description: Enhances the link command to handle setting extra attributes during link creation or modification.

methods.name: _removeExtraAttributesOnUnlinkCommandExecute
methods.description: Ensures extra attributes are removed when a link is unlinked.

methods.name: _refreshExtraAttributeValues
methods.description: Keeps the link command's attribute values in sync with the current selection.
